databaseTree.tables: SELECT TABLE_NAME AS TableName FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE';
databaseTree.views: SELECT TABLE_NAME AS ViewName FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema = DATABASE();
databaseTree.procedures: SELECT ROUTINE_NAME AS ProcedureName FROM information_schema.routines WHERE routine_schema = DATABASE() AND routine_type = 'PROCEDURE';

searchPick.tables: SELECT TABLE_NAME AS TableName FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE';
searchPick.views: SELECT TABLE_NAME AS ViewName FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema = DATABASE();
searchPick.procedures: SELECT ROUTINE_NAME AS ProcedureName FROM information_schema.routines WHERE routine_schema = DATABASE() AND routine_type = 'PROCEDURE';

databaseObject.view: SELECT VIEW_DEFINITION AS ViewDefinition FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = $viewName;
databaseObject.procedure: SELECT ROUTINE_DEFINITION AS ProcedureDefinition FROM information_schema.routines WHERE routine_schema = DATABASE() AND routine_name = $procedureName;

table.columns: SELECT column_name, data_type, character_maximum_length, is_nullable, column_default FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = SUBSTRING_INDEX($objectName, '.', -1) ORDER BY ordinal_position;
table.constraints: SELECT tc.constraint_name AS Name, tc.constraint_type AS ConstraintType, CASE WHEN tc.constraint_type IN ('PRIMARY KEY', 'UNIQUE') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS `Unique`, GROUP_CONCAT(kcu.column_name ORDER BY kcu.ordinal_position SEPARATOR ', ') AS `Columns` FROM information_schema.table_constraints AS tc LEFT JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage AS kcu ON tc.constraint_schema = kcu.constraint_schema AND tc.table_name = kcu.table_name AND tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name WHERE tc.constraint_schema = DATABASE() AND tc.table_name = SUBSTRING_INDEX($objectName, '.', -1) GROUP BY tc.constraint_name, tc.constraint_type ORDER BY tc.constraint_type, tc.constraint_name;
table.privileges: SELECT grantee, grantor, privilege_type, is_grantable FROM information_schema.table_privileges WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = SUBSTRING_INDEX($objectName, '.', -1);

view.columns: SELECT column_name, data_type, character_maximum_length, is_nullable, column_default FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = SUBSTRING_INDEX($objectName, '.', -1) ORDER BY ordinal_position;
view.privileges: SELECT grantee, grantor, privilege_type, is_grantable FROM information_schema.table_privileges WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = SUBSTRING_INDEX($objectName, '.', -1);

procedure.privileges: SELECT grantee, grantor, privilege_type, is_grantable FROM information_schema.routine_privileges WHERE routine_schema = DATABASE() AND routine_name = SUBSTRING_INDEX($objectName, '.', -1);
